title: Payment problems
content: If a customer reports a failed payment or duplicate charge, collect the order number, payment date, and payment amount. Never request full card details, CVV, or passwords. A human specialist must review the payment issue.

title: Delivery problems
content: For delivery delays, collect the order number and a description of the problem. Do not promise a delivery date without verified information. A human specialist must review the request.

title: Returns and refunds
content: For a return or refund request, collect the order number and reason for the return. Do not promise refund approval or processing times without verified information. A human specialist must review the request.
